brief: For crochet coordinator Tess, complete the seven group, accessibility and loan commissions in delegation/tess. A loan promise is different from accepted allocation, inspection and actual delivery. All people, charts and permissions are fictional.

delegation/tess.title: Tess’s seven linked commissions
delegation/tess.body: Please deliver distinct stitch packs for the morning Willow group and evening Pine group, a readable large-print chart master, the library’s two independently held large-print copies, a feasible actual kit allocation, the private fee/return ledger, an evening substitute-kit or authorized no-kit instruction sheet, and actual handoff receipts to both group coordinators plus a private summary to me. Willow needs its first pack and original kit before its morning meeting. If the chart correction or kit return changes, keep valid morning-meeting history, but correct every affected reusable library copy and send both coordinators the current chart for their next work. Pine’s final pack must describe the kit it will actually receive, or the explicitly allowed no-kit method. Do not treat a request, acceptance, or promised return as an actual inspected kit delivery.

calendar/groups.title: Group meetings and loan transport
calendar/groups.body: Minute0 is09:00. Willow meets09:40 (40). Pine meets11:05 (125); its final accessible pack and actual kit, or authorized no-kit instructions, must be received by125. The designer’s chart check and lender’s return-status report arrive at minute55. Original kit was expected back at70, but rely on the actual report. A spare kit can be inspected from minute70; inspection takes8 minutes on the one loan desk. Kit receiving transport/processing takes10 minutes then verification2 minutes. The single enlarger produces each group’s large-print copy in8 minutes. Tess stays until minute140 for private handover.

source/chart.title: Invented stitch chart, first edition
source/chart.body: Rows1–3: single crochet across six stitches. Row4: work 2 together, then single crochet across. Rows5–6: single crochet across. Use plain English labels, minimum18-point type, high contrast and no color-only instructions in all large-print copies. Designer’s check comes at55.

source/loan.title: Original kit loan position
source/loan.body: Original hook kit K1 is available now for Willow, to be received before its meeting40. The lender currently expects return at70; expectation is not actual return. Pine was provisionally pencilled in for K1 after return, subject to inspection and transit. Never allocate the same kit to overlapping actual holds.

rights/designer.title: Designer Uma’s limited permission
rights/designer.body: Both groups already have their own yarn. Uma authorizes the full fictional chart and accessible adaptations privately for Willow and Pine, their coordinators and the library’s two loan copies. Keep credit “Pattern: Uma Reed”. Do not publish full charts or attendee/fee information. An evening no-kit finger-crochet adaptation using the same corrected stitch sequence is expressly permitted and fulfils the lesson if clearly identified as no-kit.

rights/lender.title: Lender Pavel’s independent loan terms
rights/lender.body: Pavel authorizes K1 for Willow now, not an assumed later Pine delivery. For Pine, ask privately for spare kit K2 if desired. A request takes8 minutes; acceptance allocates K2 but it still needs an actual inspection from70 and actual transport receiving receipt before125. A no-kit adaptation is allowed without borrowing K2. No reply or promise makes a kit present. Keep payment and deposit data private.

contacts.title: Actual group and library receivers
contacts.body: willow-desk and pine-desk are distinct private coordinator receiving platforms; library-desk holds the reusable large-print copies. kit-willow and kit-pine are actual loan-kit receiving platforms; a completed VERIFY means the present current kit or paper copy is actually received, not merely requested. private:tess receives the private summary. Every library copy is independent; update/cancel an affected old copy, not merely a source or a supersedes label. The fulfilled morning lesson is history and must not be falsely rewritten as never delivered.

private/fees.title: Private fee and return records
private/fees.body: Willow deposit is paid; Pine fee remains unpaid. Coordinator phone numbers are private. Fee state does not grant chart reproduction rights or prove a kit returned. Keep actual payment state in the private ledger, never in chart, group instructions or public content.

service/loan.title: Shared loan desk and enlarger
service/loan.body: One loan desk inspects a spare kit for8 minutes, only from70. One enlarger makes large-print copies8 minutes each, one at a time. A chart compiler takes4 minutes. Each final group-specific large-print file must derive from the corrected chart master and identify its actual kit or no-kit method. A kit inspection artifact must identify the actual inspected kit; an allocation note is not a bench inspection.

permissions.terms: Private named groups/library only, accessible adaptation with credit.

grants.terms: Allocated K2; inspect from70 and actually deliver before125.

spare.body: Accepted: K2 is allocated to Pine. It will be available at the loan desk from70 for actual inspection; this reply is not an inspection or delivery receipt.

content.K1: Willow now; Pine provisional only after actual return/inspection

resource.title: Designer’s corrected chart
resource.body: Rows1–3: single crochet across six stitches. Row4 correction: work 2 single crochet into the first stitch, then single crochet across; do NOT work 2 together. Rows5–6: single crochet across. Keep minimum18-point type, high contrast, no color-only instructions, and Pattern: Uma Reed credit. This correction applies to reusable current copies, not a denial that Willow’s first meeting received its then-approved chart.

events.body: Uma’s scheduled chart correction is available in source/chart.

resource.title: Lender’s actual return-status report
resource.body: K1 has not returned and will not be available until145, after Pine’s meeting125. Willow’s morning delivery remains fulfilled. Pine cannot rely on the old expected return70. Choose an accepted, inspected and actually received K2, or the permitted no-kit adaptation.
